result.summary: The page is mostly well-formed, but there is one clear defect: an untranslated localization key is displayed as a section title instead of human-readable text.

issues.description: The section heading displays the raw localization key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of a translated string (e.g., 'Popular near you').
issues.suggestion: Add the missing translation for the 'home_feed.popular_title' key in the locale files, and implement a fallback (e.g., default English string) so raw keys are never shown to users.
